title: Projective morphisms are proper
statement:
Every projective morphism is
proper (the structural
morphism $\mathbf P^N_Y\to Y$ is proper, and closed immersions are
proper; the class of proper morphisms is closed under composition).

proof.text: Use the already proved library instance IsHProjective.isProper for the first conjunct. Its proof extracts the finite homogeneous-coordinate type n and closed immersion i from IsHProjective.exists_isClosedImmersion (def-kun-projective), uses properness of the relative projective-space projection (def-nagata-projective-space-base-change and lemma-nagata-projective-space-base-change-proper), and composes with the proper closed immersion (lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper and lem-weil-pbc-proper-composition). For the second conjunct, apply ProjectiveSpace.instIsProper to ULift (Fin (N + 1)), which is finite also when N = 0. For the third conjunct use the Mathlib instances that closed immersions are finite and finite morphisms are proper, as recorded in lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-proper. For the fourth conjunct install the two given properness proofs as local instances and use IsProper.instCompScheme. These four proofs give the required conjunction without any new intermediate theorem.
